note: Manually reviewed story benchmark for the Phase 16 gate. Same development across publishers (and languages, via shared canonical entities) forms one story; different events, times, and places stay apart.

articles.headline: Cabinet approves Patna Metro expansion
articles.body: The state cabinet on Sunday approved two metro corridors to Bihta and Fatuha. The revised detailed project report is due within three months for the 28 kilometre expansion backed by Rs 750 crore.

articles.headline: Two metro corridors cleared for Bihta
articles.body: Two new corridors to Bihta and Fatuha won cabinet approval. The 28 kilometre project report reaches the government in three months with Rs 750 crore set aside.

articles.headline: Patna Metro expansion gets cabinet nod
articles.body: The cabinet nod covers two corridors to Bihta. Officials confirmed the 28 kilometre network and Rs 750 crore state share for land acquisition.

articles.headline: पटना मेट्रो विस्तार को मंजूरी
articles.body: राज्य कैबिनेट ने बिहटा और फतुहा तक दो कॉरिडोर को मंजूरी दी। 28 किलोमीटर विस्तार के लिए 750 करोड़ रुपये रखे गए हैं।

articles.headline: मेट्रो कॉरिडोर मंजूर, बिहटा तक चलेगी मेट्रो
articles.body: कैबिनेट ने बिहटा तक मेट्रो कॉरिडोर मंजूर किए। तीन महीने में रिपोर्ट और 750 करोड़ का प्रावधान हुआ है।

articles.headline: Relief camps house 40,000 in north Bihar
articles.body: Camps in Supaul and Saharsa house forty thousand displaced people. Kitchens serve meals twice daily as boats ferry supplies.

articles.headline: Flood camps swell across Kosi belt
articles.body: Relief camps in Supaul filled as forty thousand people moved in. The Kosi belt administration added kitchens in Saharsa blocks.

articles.headline: बाढ़ राहत शिविरों में चालीस हजार लोग
articles.body: सुपौल और सहरसा के शिविरों में चालीस हजार लोग रह रहे हैं। कोसी क्षेत्र में नावों से राहत पहुंचाई जा रही है।

articles.headline: शिक्षक नियुक्ति परीक्षा कैलेंडर जारी
articles.body: आयोग ने 27,000 पदों के लिए दिसंबर में परीक्षा की घोषणा की। प्रवेश पत्र पहले जारी होंगे।

articles.headline: बीपीएससी कैलेंडर: दिसंबर में परीक्षा
articles.body: बीपीएससी ने 27,000 अध्यापक पदों का कैलेंडर जारी किया। दिसंबर परीक्षा के प्रवेश पत्र जल्द मिलेंगे।

articles.headline: 27,000 पदों पर भर्ती का ऐलान
articles.body: आयोग के कैलेंडर में 27,000 पदों की घोषणा हुई। अभ्यर्थी दिसंबर परीक्षा की तैयारी करें।

articles.headline: Bridge collapses a year after construction
articles.body: An under-construction bridge over the Gandak in Saran collapsed on Thursday. The road construction department ordered a probe.

articles.headline: Under-construction Gandak bridge caves in
articles.body: The Gandak bridge under construction caved in at Saran on Thursday morning. Engineers blamed pier failure as a probe began.

articles.headline: Metro fares announced for first corridor
articles.body: Monthly passes will cost commuters Rs 500 on the first operational metro corridor. Ticket vending machines arrive next month.

articles.headline: Three arrested after Patna robbery
articles.body: Police arrested three men for a jewellery shop robbery in Patna. All stolen items were recovered on Monday.

articles.headline: Minister attacks rival at Muzaffarpur rally
articles.body: Addressing supporters in Muzaffarpur, the minister accused rivals of stalling works. Workers cheered through the speech.

articles.headline: State loses Ranji thriller
articles.body: Chasing 240, the team folded for 180 in the final session. The captain blamed poor shot selection.

articles.headline: CAG flags road scheme irregularities
articles.body: The auditor flagged Rs 400 crore in irregularities across rural road schemes. The finance department promised reconciliation.

articles.headline: Teachers protest transfer policy
articles.body: School teachers demonstrated in fifteen districts against transfers. The education department appealed for calm.

articles.headline: State GDP growth pegged at 9.2 percent
articles.body: The economic survey pegged growth at 9.2 percent on construction and trade. Youth unemployment worries economists.

articles.headline: Tenders invited for metro corridor works
articles.body: Fresh tenders cover civil works on the Bihta corridor. Bidding closes next month for the metro packages.
